title: AI SRE Pattern — Agent-Driven Reliability Engineering (Anthropic at RSAC 2026)
description: Anthropic presented at RSAC 2026 on using AI agents for SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) workflows. Key insight: 'relentless AI agents can find holes humans miss' — agents systematically probe reliability gaps through exhaustive verification patterns that humans find tedious or miss entirely. The approach uses Claude agents in a loop that tests every edge case, monitors service health indicators, and generates incident reports autonomously. Quote from the session: 'It freakin worked.' Demonstrates a working pattern for agent-driven systematic verification across infrastructure.
